summary: Frontend-only validation completed for push token timeout/diagnostics update via code-path review plus mobile web preview smoke checks. New staged statuses and timeout wrappers are implemented as requested; native token path behavior remains unvalidated at runtime due no authenticated physical device in this run.

integration_issues.issue: Initial notifications route attempt timed out with preview tunnel message ('The preview environment is not responding'). Retry succeeded.

integration_issues.flow: Native push token acquisition runtime verification
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute acquiring-device-token/acquiring-expo-token runtime transitions because testing context had no authenticated physical device session.

action_items: Run authenticated Android physical-device test to confirm status transitions: requesting-permission -> acquiring-device-token -> acquiring-expo-token -> registering-backend/registered.
Force Android FCM/native token failure path and verify lastError surfaces the new actionable timeout message exactly as intended.
Recheck preview tunnel stability (intermittent ngrok/preview unavailability observed in logs).
critical_code_review_comments: usePushNotifications.ts now cleanly separates native and Expo token stages with explicit statuses ('acquiring-device-token' and 'acquiring-expo-token'), improving diagnosability.
withTimeout(...) is applied to both Notifications.getDevicePushTokenAsync() and Notifications.getExpoPushTokenAsync(...) with 12s limits, preventing indefinite hangs in registration flow.
Android-specific timeout text is actionable and points to Firebase/FCM configuration in app build, which matches the reported stall context.
pushDiagnostics.ts status union and notifications diagnostics screen bindings are updated consistently; no stale status-label mismatch found.
Web shim remains intentionally no-op (usePushNotifications.web.ts), so native push registration behavior cannot be validated in web preview runtime.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This run covered static verification of the timeout/stage-split patch and a mobile web smoke check of notifications diagnostics rendering. Native push runtime validation is pending and required for final confidence.
rca_of_issue: Patch appears to correctly address prior blind stall by isolating native token acquisition from Expo token request and bounding each with timeout. Remaining unresolved runtime risk is environmental (native FCM/APNs/device/auth availability), not obvious code regression.
